trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE CAST(p.draft_pick AS INT64) = 24 AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) < 1 RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE regexp_matches(p.draft_pick, '^24($|[^0-9])') AND CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) < 1 RETURN CAST(p.olympic_gold_medals AS INT64) AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE (p.draft_pick = '24' OR starts_with(p.draft_pick, '24th') OR starts_with(p.draft_pick, '24 ')) AND (p.olympic_gold_medals = '0' OR p.olympic_gold_medals = '0 medals') RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document) WHERE regexp_matches(p.draft_pick, '24') AND regexp_matches(p.olympic_gold_medals, '0') RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.position AS col2, p.birth_date AS col3, p.name AS name_player
